To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dynamic amplification factor of a column after sudden loss of bracing increases with axial load, decreases with bracing stiffness, increases with bracing location, and decreases with damping.
the maximum dynamic response of a pinned column with a bracing system is a function of the axial loads on the column, the stiffness of the bracing system, and the location of the bracing.

the elastic response of a column with an internal translational spring is strongly influenced by the axial loads, the stiffness of the bracing, and the location of the bracing along the length of the column.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamic response of a column after sudden removal of an internal brace.
the elastic response of a pinned column after the sudden removal of an internal brace.
the elastic response of a pinned column after sudden loss of bracing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the maximum response is a strong function of the initial deflection, the axial loads, and the bracing stiffness.

the maximum dynamic response of a column with a bracing member that is suddenly released depends on the initial axial compressive loads, the bracing stiffness, the bracing location, and the damping characteristics of the column.
the maximum dynamic displacement of the column increases with increasing initial deflection, decreasing bracing stiffness and decreasing axial load.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the elastic response of a column to sudden removal of a brace is not necessarily small.
the maximum dynamic response increases with the axial load and the bracing stiffness.
the elastic response of a column to the sudden removal of an axial brace depends on the axial load, the initial deflection, the bracing stiffness, the bracing location and the damping.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the maximum dynamic response of a column is not always greater than the maximum static response.
the maximum dynamic displacement is proportional to the initial displacement and inversely proportional to the square of the bracing stiffness.
the maximum dynamic deflection of the column is proportional to the initial deflection of the system, and that the maximum dynamic response can be reduced significantly by using an internal brace.
